title: The Rewind: Uncertainty
summary:
My point is that very few people can balance all these considerations to figure out our collective risk. But to invest in things that are out of favor, at the risk of standing out from the crowd
and appearing to have made a big mistake, takes confidence and resolve. And it takes confidence to continue holding a highly appreciated investment you think still has
has upside potential, at the risk of possibly giving up some of the gains to date.
